title: Site Reliability Engineer - Tokyo
description:
Job Overview


You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and scalability of our infrastructure and services. Working closely with development teams, you will help achieve both system stability and a rapid release cycle.


Our company has established a global development structure, accelerating collaboration among engineers based in Japan, India, and the Philippines. Within this environment, bilingual (Japanese and English) SREs serve an essential role, acting as a bridge between teams.


 


Roles and Responsibilities


 
Design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure.

 
Plan and drive cost optimization and efficiency improvements for cloud resources.

 
Improve operational efficiency through the development and implementation of automation tools.

 
Define and measure Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs).

 
Monitor systems, configure alerts, and manage and continuously improve incident response.

 
Manage incident resolution and conduct post-mortem analyses.

 
Perform capacity planning and performance tuning.

 
Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines.

 
Manage identity and access for development tools.



 


The Appeal of Mico


Mico has set an ambitious goal: to become No. 1 in Asia by 2030, with a clear vision for global expansion. Achieving this goal requires tackling numerous challenges and overcoming obstacles.


We provide an environment where you can fully leverage your skills and experience. At Mico, everyone is encouraged to take ownership and lead, making our culture of individual initiative and empowerment one of our greatest strengths.


 


Our Service：Overview of "Mico Engage AI"


Mico Engage AI offers a platform that supports B2C businesses by managing customer information and facilitating communication via a messaging platform.

 By collecting and analyzing customer data as 1st-party data, the platform enables personalized communication and information delivery, fostering customer loyalty and driving revenue growth for businesses.

 Currently, Mico Engage AI not only supports customer acquisition and engagement as a marketing tool but also enhances one-on-one communication quality post-acquisition, contributing to the maximization of LTV (Lifetime Value).

 The platform extends beyond messaging to embrace a multi-channel strategy. With "Vision2030," we aim to become "Asia’s No.1 Brand Empowerment Company," driving business development with a focus on the global market.


 


Challenges We Address


 

 Leadership in the Conversational Commerce Market

 In the rapidly growing conversational commerce (C-commerce) market, especially in Asia, Mico Engage AI is striving to become the leading solution.

 Effective results in C-commerce require more than scattershot strategies. By unifying, analyzing, and improving communication between businesses and consumers, Mico Engage AI enables businesses to optimize their online marketing efforts on an individualized level.

 

 Streamlining Marketing Operations

 Many marketing professionals struggle to dedicate time to strategic tasks due to the burden of daily operations.

 By improving operational efficiency through Mico Engage AI, we aim to create a world where businesses can focus on creative work while providing consumers with more enjoyable and seamless purchasing experiences.



 


The Appeal of Working at Mico


 
Rapid growth in the C-commerce market, achieving strong business expansion, funding success, and the No.1 position in LINE marketing in Japan.

 
A customer-first culture, "WOW THE CUSTOMER," focused on solving real challenges and delivering exceptional results.

 
A collaborative team with an "OPEN MIND" and "ALL FOR ONE" spirit, offering daily inspiration and opportunities for growth.



 


About the Tools, Languages, and Environment


 
Web Backend : TypeScript (Nest.js), partial usage of Java (Spring Boot)

 
Web Frontend : TypeScript (Next.js), Chakra UI

 
Database : TiDB, Aurora MySQL, MemoryDB for Redis

 
Infrastructure : AWS, Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

 
Middleware : Nginx, Supervisor

 
Monitoring : NewRelic, Sentry, AWS (CloudWatch)

 
Data Analysis : BigQuery, Google Data Studio, Google Analytics, Metabase, Trocco

 
Environment Setup : Docker

 
CI/CD : GitHub Actions, Amplify Hosting, CloudFront

 
Source Code Management : GitHub

 
Communication Tools : Google Meet, Slack, Notion, Redmine, Jira, ClickUp



*The technical stack may vary slightly depending on the product you will be working on.


 


Required Skills


 
Daily conversational Japanese is acceptable if you have Business-level English fluency.

 
Experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, etc.).

 
Practical experience in Linux/Unix system administration.

 
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

 
Hands-on experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

 
Experience building and operating monitoring services.

 
Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines.

 
Basic knowledge of networking.



 


Preferred Skills

Ideal Candidate Profile

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Posting - Infrastructure Engineer


Company description:


Rokken is a software development company that provides customized solutions to meet its clients' needs. Our expertise primarily focuses on designing innovative applications in the fields of machine learning and real-time 3D visualization, combined with experience in the medical sector.


 


Job offer description:


We are seeking a skilled Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, and manage our growing in-house computational infrastructure. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our technical capabilities from the ground up. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with distributed computing systems, cloud technologies, and infrastructure management. This role is crucial in enhancing our computational capabilities for machine learning, software development, and other resource-intensive tasks.


 


Annual compensation:


 
6,000,000 to 8,500,000 yen



 


Current Infrastructure and Growth Plans:


We currently have around 25 PCs in our cluster, with plans for significant expansion. As our first Infrastructure Engineer, you'll have the unique opportunity to design and implement scalable systems that will grow with our company.


 


Language Requirements


 
English: Business Level (required)

 
Japanese: Not required



 


Minimum Experience


 
Mid-level or above



 


In this role, you will:


 
Design, implement, and manage our in-house computational cluster, planning for future growth.

 
Optimize resource allocation and utilization across our growing number of PCs.

 
Set up and maintain distributed computing systems for ML training and other tasks.

 
Implement and manage containerization and orchestration solutions.

 
Establish and maintain a distributed file system for efficient data storage and access.

 
Configure and manage various development and operational tools.

 
Implement monitoring, backup, and security solutions for the cluster.

 
Set up and manage web services and ML backends.

 
Collaborate closely with ML engineers and software developers to understand their needs and design optimal solutions.

 
Document all systems, processes, and best practices.

 
Participate in backend development projects, particularly related to running ML tasks on the cluster.



 


Minimum Qualifications:


 
3+ years of experience in infrastructure management or similar roles.

 
Strong Linux administration skills.

 
Proficiency with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker).

 
Experience with distributed computing systems and workload managers.

 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
Strong documentation and communication skills.

 
Proficiency with version control systems, especially Git.



 


Preferred Qualifications:


 
Experience with cluster management tools (e.g., Slurm, Kubernetes).

 
Knowledge of distributed file systems (e.g., Ceph, MinIO, JuiceFS).

 
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and self-hosted runners.

 
Experience with network management and VPN solutions (e.g., Tailscale).

 
Knowledge of monitoring and logging solutions for distributed systems.

 
Experience with package management systems (e.g., PIP, VCPKG).

 
Familiarity with backup strategies for large-scale systems.

 
Experience with hybrid cloud/on-premises setups.

 
Familiarity with cloud technologies and services.

 
Backend development experience, particularly in the context of ML workloads.



 


Relocation Support for foreign Candidates


 
Assistance for visa sponsorship and application.

 
Help with finding housing.

 
Support for daily life in Japan:
 
 
Registering at the city office and opening a bank account.

 
 



 


Trial period:


 

 
3 months

 



 


Remote work policy:


 
While remote work is allowed, due to the nature of cluster management tasks, we expect the successful candidate to live in close proximity to our office location.

 
Initial Phase:
 
 
On-site work at our office location.

 
 

 
Following Initial Assessment:
 
 
Flexible work arrangements possible, with regular on-site presence required.

 
 



If you're passionate about building and managing high-performance computing environments and want to play a crucial role in shaping the technological future of a growing company, we'd love to hear from you!

AI Internships 
Which AI internships are open for the 2027 cycle, what each publishes as pay, the deadlines closing this autumn, and the employers running none at all — checked on 23 September 2026.
 
Updated September 2026
 
Quick answer: The 2027 AI internship cycle is open now, and the application window for most of it is autumn 2026 rather than spring 2027. The nearest hard deadline is Microsoft Research’s Undergraduate Research Internship, which closes on 5 October 2026 — twelve days from this page. The highest published pay in the category is not at an AI lab: IMC’s machine learning research internship lists a base salary of $300,000 and Citadel’s machine learning researcher PhD internship lists $4,300 to $5,800 per week, against $20 to $71 per hour at Nvidia and $40 to $85 per hour at Netflix. Two of the best-known AI employers run no conventional internship at all: Anthropic’s only early-career research route is its Fellows Program, and OpenAI had no live 2027 intern requisition when we checked.


This page is about structured, employer-run internships — fixed-term placements for people who are enrolled in a degree. If you are looking for paid AI work with no degree and no enrolment requirement, that is a different market entirely and it is covered at best AI jobs for beginners and AI training jobs. For what the salaried version of these roles pays afterwards, see AI salaries.


Every posting, deadline and pay figure below was checked at the employer’s own careers page or job board on 23 September 2026. Postings in this category expire, move and get replaced within days. Where an employer publishes no figure, this page says “data not available” rather than estimating one.



The three different things called an “AI internship”

These three are often merged, which is what makes pay figures across the category hard to compare.



































RouteWho it is forTypical lengthEnrolment requiredTypical published payEmployer internshipStudents returning to a degree afterwards10 to 14 weeksYes$20 to $85 per hourResidency or fellowshipCareer changers and post-degree researchers4 to 12 monthsNo, and sometimes barred$3,850 per week to $18,333 per monthAI training and annotation workAnyone accepted by the platformOpen-ended, by the taskNoBy the hour or by the task


The rest of this page covers the first row. Residencies and fellowships are a genuinely different route with different eligibility — OpenAI’s residency FAQ states that residents are full-time employees and “cannot be actively enrolled in any school programs”, which is the exact opposite of every internship listed here. Platform work is covered at AI data annotation platforms.



What is open right now

Checked at source on 23 September 2026. Where a posting’s body would not render to an automated reader, the row says so rather than repeating an aggregator’s version of it.

Mountain View and London


Four employers on that list publish a job body that an automated reader cannot retrieve — AMD, IBM, Waymo and Apple all serve their postings through JavaScript. The requisitions exist and the titles are correct. Any pay figure you see quoted for them online did not come from the posting.


Apple’s live intern requisitions carry no cycle year except one. The only date range Apple publishes in a title is Intern Opportunities at Apple, General, October 2026 to September 2027, which is a pipeline requisition rather than a summer programme. Its Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence Undergrad Internships requisition is live and undated.



The deadlines that matter before November

Four dated items, because everything else on this page is rolling and will still be there next month.


Microsoft Research closes on 5 October 2026. Its undergraduate research internship page states that “applications for Summer 2027 are now accepted until October 5th, 2026”. It is a 12-week programme in Redmond, New York City or New England, it requires two written essays, and it is restricted to rising juniors and rising seniors on a bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, information science or a related major. Microsoft Research publishes no pay figure for it.


Amazon Japan closes in mid-October 2026. Its applied scientist internship states an application and assessment deadline of “Mid October, 2026”, selection communication beginning end of October 2026, and offers extended between December 2026 and March 2027. It runs 8 to 12 weeks in Tokyo in summer 2027, and it targets students graduating in 2029. No pay figure is published.


Netflix’s machine learning internships are winter, not summer. Both are Winter 2027, with a start date in the second week of January 2027. They are PhD-only, and the posting states applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and the window stays open “until roles are filled”. Netflix has zero summer 2027 internships posted, company-wide — its entire open internship set on 23 September 2026 was three roles.


Google’s Canadian research internship window runs to 26 February 2027, and its student researcher window to 16 July 2027, both with Google’s own caveat that they “may close earlier if all available projects are full”. Both are PhD-level. The research internship is restricted to students in their penultimate academic year.



What AI internships actually pay

Three things to note before the numbers.


Annualised figures are not what you get paid. Amazon’s posting says “109,395.00 USD Annually” for a placement its own text limits to 12 weeks. IMC’s says “Base Salary: $300,000” for a placement of 10 to 12 weeks. Neither intern receives that sum. Both are annualised rates.


Weekly and hourly figures are the ones that survive multiplication. Citadel publishes $4,300 to $5,800 per week, and Citadel Securities $4,500 to $5,800. Two Sigma publishes $4,900 per week for bachelor’s, $5,000 for master’s and $5,500 for PhD on its quantitative researcher internship, and $3,800, $3,900 and $4,200 on its software engineering internship. Those are the numbers that survive being multiplied out.


Base pay and total compensation are not the same number. Salesforce states its $43 to $52 per hour “represents base salary only”. Netflix states its $40 to $85 per hour “is based on total compensation (vs. only base salary), which is in line with our compensation philosophy”. Comparing the two directly is a mistake.


Against all of that, the national benchmark is much lower than any figure on this page. The National Association of Colleges and Employers puts the average hourly wage for bachelor’s-degree-level interns at $23.35, in its 2026 Guide to Compensation for Interns and Co-ops. That figure reflects wages as of summer 2025, from a survey of 284 organisations fielded between 15 October 2025 and 4 January 2026, across all majors rather than technology alone. AI internships pay two to three times the national intern average, and the quantitative trading firms pay an order of magnitude more than that.


Pay figures nobody publishes. Meta, Apple, IBM, AMD, Qualcomm, Adobe and Microsoft publish no intern pay figure on any page we could read. Anthropic, Cohere, Mistral, Scale AI and Sierra publish none either. That is more than half of the best-known names in the category. Treat any specific dollar figure attached to those employers as unsourced unless it links to the employer’s own posting.



The employers that run no AI internship at all

Anthropic runs no conventional internship. Its Greenhouse board carried 626 open jobs on 23 September 2026 and no requisition with “intern” in the title in its AI research and engineering section. The only early-career research route is the Anthropic Fellows Program, which runs three tracks — AI safety and security, ML systems and reinforcement learning, and the Anthropic Institute for economics and policy. It is a four-month fellowship rather than a student placement, its listing published $3,850 per week plus roughly $15,000 a month of compute when we checked it on 22 September 2026, and it does not sponsor visas.


OpenAI had no live 2027 intern requisition. Its emerging talent page describes internships, residencies and full-time roles as three strands, but the two intern requisition URLs that surface in search both return dead pages. What is live is a full-time role rather than an internship: Software Engineer, Applied Emerging Talent (2027) in San Francisco, listed at $180,000 plus equity, for candidates with a bachelor’s or master’s and zero to one years of experience. The separate OpenAI Residency states plainly that “applications for the 2026 Residency are now closed” and pays $18,333 monthly.


No live intern requisition of any kind was found at Cursor, Midjourney, Character.AI, Stability AI or Groq. Runway publishes an Acceleration Program — three months, converting engineers into machine learning engineer roles — instead of an internship.


SpaceXAI’s only intern postings are infrastructure roles from the 2026 cycle. SpaceX acquired xAI in a deal announced on 2 February 2026 and the company now trades as SpaceXAI; its Greenhouse board listed 275 open jobs on 23 September 2026. The two intern requisitions on it are mechanical, electrical and controls roles in data centre infrastructure at Memphis and Southaven, for summer 2026. There is no AI or machine learning research internship. The separate SpaceX board does carry summer 2027 software engineering internships.



The stale pages that read as current

Every one of these was live and read as current on 23 September 2026.


Adobe Research’s internships page is frozen in a cycle that has already ended. It states, in the present tense, “research and engineering internships for 2026 are now open to applicants pursuing PhD and Master’s degrees” and “2026 internships will be offered as hybrid roles for summer 2026”. Summer 2026 finished weeks ago. The page is otherwise maintained — its footer reads 2026 and it links Adobe Summit 2026 news — so only the internship copy is stale. There is no 2027 Adobe Research internship posting. Adobe does have a live 2027 Intern, Software Engineer requisition in San Jose, which is not a research role.


Nvidia runs 2026 and 2027 twins side by side. “Nvidia 2026 Internships: Deep Learning” and “Nvidia 2027 Internships: Deep Learning” are near-identical titles on the same site. The 2027 requisition is JR2023497. Check the number, not the title.


Salesforce hides its AI research internships on a second job board. Its main careers site runs on one Workday tenant and its AI research requisitions run on a separate Salesforce_Research tenant. A student searching the main site will not see research roles at all. Separately, its Summer 2026 AI Research requisition still resolves as a URL and still reads as live in search results, while the Workday record itself returns no description — the signature of a pulled requisition.


Two title conventions mean the opposite of what they look like. Netflix’s “Winter 2027” roles start in January 2027, which places them in the cycle before summer 2027, not after it. Amazon’s “Class of 2029” internship is a summer 2027 placement — 2029 is the graduation year it targets.


Qualcomm publishes nothing readable. Its Americas internships page returns “You need to enable JavaScript to run this app” and no listing. An aggregator lists a Qualcomm summer 2027 machine learning internship; no Qualcomm URL corroborates it.



Eligibility: the graduation-date window is the real filter

The published eligibility rules turn on graduation date, and the windows are narrow.



























































EmployerPublished eligibilityAmazonDegree conferral between October 2027 and September 2029, with at least one term remaining after the internshipScale AIGraduation in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028, bachelor’sDatabricksGraduating Fall 2027 or Spring 2028, bachelor’s or master’sSierraGraduating December 2027 to June 2028Together AIDegree earned or expected by summer 2028IMCPhD, graduating September 2027 to July 2028Microsoft ResearchRising junior or rising senior, bachelor’sGooglePhD, penultimate academic year, for the research internshipNetflixPhD, returning to study for at least one term afterwardsSalesforceReturning to school after summer 2027, enrolled in North AmericaNvidiaEnrolled in a BS, MS or PhD for the full duration of the internshipCohereEnrolled in any post-secondary programme


Two patterns. The frontier-adjacent research roles are overwhelmingly PhD-only — Google, Netflix, IMC, Citadel, Two Sigma and Waymo’s machine learning tracks all require one. The bachelor’s-accessible roles are mostly software engineering roles at AI companies rather than AI research roles, which is a real distinction in what you will actually do.


And one rule that catches people: Nvidia requires the anticipated graduation date, in month and year, on the CV itself to be considered. Google requires the same plus a transcript in English.



International students: the rules changed, and then a court stopped them

If you need US work authorisation, this section matters more than the pay tables.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About us

 We’re an early stage fintech company building a better way to pay. We’re a small team where engineers work closely with product, design, and business, and where clear thinking and clear communication matter as much as the code itself.


What you’ll work on


 
Features end to end, from the user interface down to the services and data models behind them.

 
Turning loosely defined problems into clear plans, and getting the right people aligned before building.

 
Writing design proposals and technical documents that help the team make good decisions.

 
Deciding when something should ship quickly and when it deserves a deeper redesign, and explaining that trade-off to technical and non-technical colleagues alike.

 
Spotting tech debt early and making the case for addressing it.



Who we’re looking for


 
You’ve worked as an engineer in a professional setting and can talk in detail about systems you built, how they held up over time, and what you learned from them.

 
You explain complex ideas simply, in writing and in conversation. People come to you when they need something clarified.

 
You ask for feedback on your work, take it seriously, and can point to times it changed your approach.

 
You pick up unfamiliar tools and domains quickly, and you’re comfortable being productive before you know everything.

 
You can take a goal and run with it independently, while keeping others informed without being asked.

 
You’re comfortable across the stack. Leaning frontend or backend is fine.



Nice to have


 
Experience in payments, banking, or other domains where correctness is a priority.

 
Experience at an early stage company, or a clear reason you want to be at one now.

 
Business level Japanese (N2+)



Our stack

 Frontend: TypeScript/JavaScript, SvelteKit, Swift, Kotlin, React 

 Backend: Go, ConnectRPC/Protobuf, Temporal, PostgreSQL

 Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform


You don’t need experience with all of these. We’d love to talk with someone who has gone deep on a few and learns the rest quickly.


What it’s like here


 
Direct access to decision makers. Good ideas get heard and acted on quickly.

 
Real ownership of your work, with support from the team when you need it.

 
A culture of open, honest feedback in both directions.



How to apply

 Along with your resume, send a short written note about a technical problem you solved at work. Tell us what the constraints were, what you tried that didn’t work, and what you’d change today. We’d love to hear this in your own words, since how you explain your thinking matters to us as much as the problem itself.

title: Engineering Manager - Store Applications
description:
概要 (Overview)


店舗スタッフや現場オペレーターが日々使うソフトウェアを担うチームを率いる、実装にも踏み込むエンジニアリングマネージャーを募集しています。エンジニアリング、プロダクト、ピープルマネジメントを横断して担うポジションで、技術と利用現場の両方に向き合いながら、実店舗で稼働中のシステムを安定運用しつつ進化させる強いチームを築ける方を求めています。


 


Summary:



店舗スタッフ・現場オペレーションを支える本番稼働中のソフトウェアのエンジニアリングをリードする。


実装に踏み込む技術リーダーシップ — コードを読み、レビューし、必要に応じて自ら実装する。


ハイブリッドな技術スタック: 既存のUnity / Blazor / C#アプリケーションを維持しながら、より新しいReact / TypeScriptスタックへ段階的に移行する。


BizDev、Operations、その他の関連するエンジニアリングチームと協働する。


チームを採用し、育て、運営する。採用、コーチング、計画立案、スタンダードの整備まで担う。



 


Team & Platform Context:


私たちは、バックエンドとエッジ間通信サービスの双方で C#（.NET）を活用し、システム横断で一貫した開発を行っています。ロボット側は NVIDIA Jetson AGX上で ROS/C++/Pythonが動作し、クラウドサービスとは常時接続しているデーモンを経由して接続します。


 


The Challenge: Software Meets Hardware


本ポジションが扱うソフトウェア（フロントエンド/バックエンド双方）は、エンドユーザーの直接の接点であるため、要求は常に多様で変化し続けます。ここでは、ソフトウェア開発の速度とハードウェア開発の制約を同時に扱うことが求められます。また、単なるコーディングやSaaS開発に留まりません。制約の中で現実的に前へ進める柔軟性と、組織全体のソフトウェアエンジニアリング水準を引き上げるリーダーシップが求められます。



Bridging the Cycle Gap: ハードウェアや自動化の開発サイクルは、純粋なソフトウェア開発より長くなるのが通常です。ハードウェアの準備を待つだけでなく、ソフトウェア側の工夫で課題を回避したり、ハードウェア完成前に価値検証のための機能を先に実装したりする判断が必要になります。


Elevating Engineering Standards: 他ドメインの専門チームはそれぞれ高い専門性を持つ一方、モダンSaaSの開発実務や NFR（非機能要件）に必ずしも強くない場合があります。このロールは、ソフトウェア開発の共通知見を橋渡しし、システム全体の堅牢性とスケーラビリティを高める役割を担います。



 


職務内容 (Responsibilities)


Lead product engineering for Store Applications


他チームと連携し、曖昧な要求をチームが実行できるエンジニアリングプランに具体化します。技術的な実現可能性、UX実装品質、デリバリーリスク、現場オペレーションの実態を要件整理の議論に持ち込むことで、このロールは意思決定に関与し、担当領域では必要に応じて意思決定を担うことが期待されます。



曖昧なプロダクト要求・運用要求を、実行可能なエンジニアリングプランに落とし込む


プロダクト・UX・技術・デリバリーの各リスクを早期に可視化し、不明瞭な要件には具体的な代替案を提示する


ロードマップとスコープの意思決定に対して、エンジニアリング観点から提案・助言し、担当領域では必要に応じて意思決定を担う



 


UX Quality and Design System Adoption


本ポジションは、チームが提供するユーザー体験の品質に責任を持ちます。デザイナーとしてではなく、デザイン意図やUX要件がレガシー・モダン双方のフロントエンド実装で損なわれないように導くエンジニアリングリーダーとして関わります。店舗スタッフの業務上の摩擦をどれだけ減らせたかを、実際の指標で継続的に確認することが前提です。



デザインシステム（Figma、Tailwind CSS、shadcn/ui、React）のエンジニアリング実装と社内浸透をリードする


レガシーとモダン双方の画面・接点で、一貫したユーザー体験を維持する


成果はコンポーネント数ではなく、現場オペレーションの摩擦を実際にどれだけ減らせたかで測る



 


Drive technical execution and modernization


既存のUnity / Blazor / C#コードベースと、立ち上がりつつあるReact / TypeScriptの方向性をまたいでチームを導きます。本番稼働中のオペレーションを止めないよう、モダン化の順序を慎重に設計することがこのロールの重要な役割です。バックエンドリードとフロントエンドリードは各ドメイン内で技術的な権限を持ち、このロールはスタック横断での足ないみとエリア全体の一貫性に責任を持ちます。



マイグレーション作業のシーケンスを設計し、稼働店舗へのリスクを最小化する


プロダクションコードを定期的に読み、レビューし、必要に応じて書く


Store Applications領域全体で技術的負債を管理し、トレードオフの議論をリードする



 


Own production delivery and reliability


これらのシステムは実店舗で稼働しているため、安全なデリバリーは最低条件です。CI/CD、テスト、可観測性、ホットフィックス、ロールバック、インシデント対応まで含め、担当領域全体のリリース品質と本番運用準備に責任を持ち、インシデントから得た学びを計画に反映します。



担当領域全体のCI/CD、リリース品質、ホットフィックス／ロールバック、インシデント対応に責任を持つ


実店舗環境向けに、テスト、可観測性、運用準備の水準を継続的に引き上げる


本番からのフィードバックをエンジニアリングの優先順位に確実に反映する



 


Build and grow the team


エンジニアの採用・コーチング・マネジメントを行い、エンジニアリングの標準を定め、プロダクションソフトウェアを責任を持って運用できるチームを作ります。メンバーの成長とチームの健全性は、周辺業務ではなく中核業務です。



エンジニアを採用しマネジメントする。1on1を行い、メンバーを育てる


コード品質、テスト、レビュー、本番運用準備に関するスタンダードを整備する


計画品質、キャパシティ管理、デリバリーの予測可能性を改善していく



 


応募要件 (Requirements)


マネージャー、テックリード、あるいは強いプロダクトエンジニアリングリードとしてエンジニアリングをリードした経験があり、実ユーザーが頼りにするソフトウェアをリリース・運用してきた方を想定しています。スピード、品質、信頼性、UX、保守性のあいだで地に足のついたトレードオフを下せること、速度と信頼性のバランスを高い解像度で非エンジニアに対しても説明できることが重要です。


 


Must have:



C# / .NETを中心としたソフトウェア開発の実務経験、および本番稼働中システムでの設計・実装・運用経験


フロントエンドまたはユーザー向けプロダクト開発経験（Unity / Blazor / React / TypeScriptいずれかの実務経験を含む）


REST API / gRPCの基本理解と、フロントエンド・バックエンド間の連携設計または実装経験


Git/GitHubを用いた開発フロー（コードレビュー、ブランチ運用、CI/CD連携）での実務経験


テスト・可観測性・障害対応を含む運用品質の改善経験（テスト設計、監視、リリース/ロールバック運用など）


エンジニア、エンジニアリングチーム、または強いプロダクトエンジニアリングのイニシアチブをリードした経験


曖昧な要件を実行可能なエンジニアリングプランに翻訳し、関係者と合意形成できる力


日本語（ネイティブもしくは、JLPT N1相当）と英語（ビジネスレベル）でのコミュニケーション能力



 


Nice to have:



Azure / Docker / Kubernetesを利用したサービス運用または改善経験


Redis / MongoDB / PostgreSQLのいずれかを用いたデータモデリング・運用経験


デザインシステム実装経験（Figma / Tailwind CSS / shadcn/uiなど）


IoT / ロボティクス / リテールオペレーション領域のソフトウェア開発または運用経験


レガシースタックからモダンスタックへの段階的移行（移行計画、並行運用、リスク管理）の推進経験


エンジニア採用、育成、評価、1on1などのピープルマネジメント実務経験

Technical Program Manager Intern 2027

Job ID: 10589099 | Amazon.com Services LLC





Apply now













Description
Shape what comes next | Discover careers in Tech

At Amazon, our tech isn't just a tool, it's your playground. Our engineers work on scalable systems, cloud services, and customer-facing products that operate at global scale. This is an environment where you learn by building. Whether you're creating cloud-native solutions, optimizing machine learning models, or building products that drive experiences for millions of customers around the globe, your work reaches the world, fast. You'll take ownership early, collaborate across teams and disciplines, and grow your skills as you tackle new problems. There's no single path forward here, with a chance to explore different directions and shape your journey as you go. This is where ambition meets opportunity and, where the impact of what you build helps define what comes next, for customers and for you. 

What's in it for you? 

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You'll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus. 
Amazon internships across all seasons are full-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work-day.

Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes. By applying to this position, your application will be considered for all technical program manager (TPM) internship roles at all locations we hire for in the United States including but not limited to: Greater Seattle Area (Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond), Greater Bay Area (San Francisco, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara), Greater DMV (DC, MD, VA), Austin (TX), New York City (NY), Minneapolis (MN). 
Start dates for our internships in this posting include the following periods:
1. Winter (Starts January/February 2027)
2. Summer (Starts May/June 2027) 
3. Fall (Starts August/September 2027)

You will be able to provide your preference of location and start date during the application process but, we cannot guarantee that we can meet your selection based on several factors including but not limited to the availability and business needs of this role. Finalization on the location and start dates available will be provided to you at the time of job offer. 

TPM interns apply project management best practices to make the team you work with more efficient. You will be responsible for driving projects from initiation through delivery, collaborating with many different teams to complete a whole product. As a TPM intern, you know how to apply technology to solve problem and take the time to fully learn the products and systems involved with your projects. 

Key job responsibilities
As a Technical Program Manager intern, you may:
• Collaborate and partner with business teams to define and solve problems that impact customers. 
• Define project requirements and work to clarify the technical implementation by driving design discussions
• Identify predictors and causes of business related problems and implement novel approaches related to forecasting and prediction.
• Identify, develop, manage, and execute analyses to uncover areas of opportunity and present written business recommendations.
• Build relationships, identify stakeholders, and influence other teams across organizations and external teams.
• Define analytical approaches to uncover new insights and formulate recommendations that improve processes.
• Influence technology at the component level.
• Interface with engineering disciplines to deliver project requirements

A day in the life
Our internship program provides hands-on learning and building experiences for students who are interested in a career in industrial design engineering. In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in fun activities with other interns throughout the summer. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your internship and learn in a real-world setting.



Basic Qualifications
- Are enrolled in a academic program that is physically located in the United States
- Bachelor's degree or above in a technical or engineering related field, such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, etc.
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience previously in program or project management
- Work 40 hours/week minimum and commit to a 12 week internship maximum



Preferred Qualifications
- Knowledge of project management tools and software
- Knowledge of industry technologies in program or product domain (e.g., hardware, network, software, systems) and how to apply those technologies to solve problems
- Knowledge of collecting data from log files, data stores, SQL, and APIs
- Experience transforming raw thoughts into clear technical documentation and/or direction.
- Able to dive deeply into technical details (e.g. key dependencies, design choices, operability, etc.) and drive constructive discussions with engineers
- Strong technical, problem-solving and communication skills

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.


The starting pay for this position is listed below. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.
